headline: Chipotle Anticipates Higher Sales Driven by Expansion of Chipotlanes
summary: Chipotle expects modestly higher sales this year, aided by menu-price increases and the rollout of drive-thru Chipotlanes, despite rising beef costs.
why: Chipotle Mexican Grill is a major fast-casual restaurant chain whose margins and sales growth serve as an indicator of consumer discretionary spending and food cost inflation.

impacts.name: Chipotle Mexican Grill
impacts.why: Higher expected sales and menu-price increases support revenue growth despite rising beef costs.
